audit.why: EVEN at 5.5/10 on 51.66% over 1444 games, with both the packet chart and the content chart giving Galio all seven stages. The lane is a range problem only: Overload reaches 1000 on a 5s cooldown, but Rune Prison and Spell Flux are both 615, so he has to enter Galio's 825 Q range to do anything except chip.

The spike map on the content layer is right and does not need moving: Galio's power is levels 3-5 into 6 (Justice Punch 11s, Hero's Entrance 180s at 4000 range), Ryze's is late once he has mana and AP for the Flux chain. Realm Warp is 180s at 3000 range and is a repositioning portal, not a fight-winner, which is what spikes[1] and mid already say.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanical errors repeated across the page: (a) Justice Punch is called a stun in whys[1], spikes[0].text and early — it is a knockup; (b) Ryze is repeatedly said to have a dash ('his short dash range' in whys[1] and wants.you[0], 'punishing every dash-in attempt' in mid). Ryze has no dash in his kit. Also, Rune Prison is labelled '(Root)' everywhere but only roots conditionally.
audit.why: ownerKit E: 'knocking up the first enemy champion he encounters'. Ryze's kit is Overload (projectile), Rune Prison (615, hardCC + slow), Spell Flux (615, projectile), Realm Warp (portal) — no dash flag anywhere. enemyKit W is explicit: 'trapping a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' So the root only exists after Spell Flux lands, and Spell Flux is the ability to watch.
audit.corrected: Justice Punch knocks up. Ryze cannot dash — he walks. Rune Prison slows unless Spell Flux is already on you, in which case it roots; the orb is the tell, not the cage.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[2].d invented a magnitude — 'take the fifteen-second invitation' for an 11s ability. wants.you[0] and early also told the reader to step up 'whenever E is down', but Spell Flux is 3.5s at rank 1 and 2.5s at rank 5, so it is effectively never down.
audit.why: Rune Prison 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 is the punishable cooldown in this lane; Spell Flux is not, and Overload at 5s flat is not either.
audit.corrected: Numbers written in; the window re-pointed from Spell Flux to Rune Prison's 11 seconds; fifteen corrected to eleven.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: The titles are about taunting the step-up and about not spending E on the wave; the bodies described a trade rotation.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to their own titles, on the 615-versus-825 range gap and Justice Punch's 11s.
